messages:
anya: Hey devex — running through the Node quickstart and hitting a wall. I set REDWOOD_API_KEY in my env and curl returns 401. Node SDK also fails. Any ideas?

sam: Can you paste the exact curl and the minimal SDK snippet you used?

anya: curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate  

lina: 401 usually means an invalid key or a key blocked by workspace billing. Did you create the key from a workspace or from your personal account?

anya: I made it from the workspace settings (was invited to workspace "acme-poc"). I don't remember seeing any billing prompt when I accepted. How can I check if the workspace is gated?

billing-bot: workspace acme-poc status: TRIAL_EXPIRED — billing_required. Hosted API usage is blocked until a payment method is added. Please visit https://app.redwood.ai/workspace/acme-poc/billing or contact billing@redwood.ai to request a trial extension.

sam: That explains it — workspace keys are blocked when billing is required. Two quick options: 1) add a payment method to the workspace, or 2) generate a personal API key from your Account page and use that for quick testing.

anya: switched to a personal key (Account -> API keys) and curl worked. But the Node SDK earlier gave 403 with a short body: { error: "billing_required" }. Why different codes?

lina: We sometimes return 401 for auth problems and 403 for policy/billing blocks. We should make that consistent and surface a human-friendly error — good catch. Can you paste your Node snippet?

anya: const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-1', input: 'hi' });
// error: 403 { error: 'billing_required' }

sam: Yep that's the billing_required signal. We'll triage why curl showed 401 earlier (maybe an env substitution issue) and why SDK returned 403; both are legit but confusing.

matt: I've opened a small docs PR to add a note in quickstart: "If you were invited to a workspace, workspace keys may be blocked until billing is configured — use a personal key for initial testing." Also filing a bug to include a direct link in the SDK error payload.

anya: confirmed resolved for me after switching to a personal key. First successful call! :party-parrot: :tada:

lina: Awesome. Leaving a short onboarding checklist for DX improvements: 1) quickstart docs: clarify workspace vs personal keys, 2) SDK: include machine-readable billing reason + human link, 3) Console: make billing status more visible on invite flow.

sam: +1. Tagging @product for prioritization and @eng for the SDK error payload change. Thanks for reporting and confirming, @anya.
